usageExamples.text: After editing a TypeScript file, show the diagnostics returned by the configured checker.

requirements: Configure checker argv and file extensions for your toolchain. The plugin has no built-in checker commands.

configurationExamples.code:
- id: lens-lite
  config:
    tools: [write, edit, str_replace_editor]
    maxDiagnosticChars: 4000
    checkers:
      - name: tsc
        extensions: ['.ts', '.tsx']
        argv: ['npx', '--no-install', 'tsc', '--noEmit']
        cwd: '.'
        timeoutMs: 60000

requirements: Set DSH_WEBHOOK_SECRET to a private shared secret. Empty secrets reject every webhook request.
The default listener is 127.0.0.1:8788. Agent replies require the configured deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash provider and model.
Channel mappings are kept in memory. A supplied reply_url can receive agent output over HTTP or HTTPS.

usageExamples.text: curl http://127.0.0.1:8788/health
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8788/hook/example -H "Authorization: Bearer $DSH_WEBHOOK_SECRET" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"message":"Review this project"}'
